verdict.rationale: BVNK's own docs describe funding in stablecoins and paying out in fiat, plus fiat payouts to first- or third-party bank accounts. They also mention virtual accounts in USD, EUR and GBP and a 130+ countries reach. However, no published off-ramp corridor list names the payout rails (e.g., SEPA/ACH/Faster Payments) or the supported payout currencies by country. missing for 10: a published per-currency/per-country off-ramp payout coverage list, named bank-transfer rails, an end-to-end stablecoin-to-bank-payout guide, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops lead, recipients can land in local fiat — documented off-ramp rails that convert stablecoins into bank transfers across a published set of currencies and countries

citations.quote: fund in stablecoins and pay out in fiat
It is possible to create both a payout to themselves (first party) or a payout to another bank account (third party).
Create virtual accounts in USD, EUR, GBP for your business or customers.
Send, receive, store, and convert funds across 130+ countries.
